summary: External companies and their consultants now have their own page with built-in reviews.

new.title: External Companies page
new.text: One row per external company with its contacts, sponsor department, review cadence and consultants. The contacts get the access review mail and confirm or deny each consultant.

fixes.title: Clearer portal sign-in field
fixes.text: The request portal's sign-in field now asks for the Admin Account (UPN) or e-mail address.
